page: Microsoft Azure NC24lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a specialized GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 24 dedicated Intel vCPUs alongside 72.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a fractional 0.25 partition of an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 6000 GPU with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM, making it tailored for graphics workloads and lower-density compute tasks requiring modern GPU capabilities.

For high-speed I/O requirements, the instance includes 1993 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The local storage provides rapid data access for cache-heavy pipelines and scratch disks, while the system configuration omits complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring private networking or dedicated IP allocation for external communication.

The fractional GPU allocation delivers a cost-efficient profile for workloads that demand modern GPU architecture features without the financial footprint of a full dedicated enterprise GPU. With 24 dedicated Intel cores, 72.0 GB of memory, and substantial NVMe capacity, the NC24lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is suited for medium-scale GPU workstation duties, visual computing, rendering, AI inference, and development environments processing local datasets.
